metadata.name: molpha
metadata.description: Molpha Oracle Solana Program - Merged from molpha-solana and molpha-feed

accounts.name: node
docs: The operator's current slot account, holding `claimable_rewards` while active. Omitted once
the operator is deactivated (its slot has been closed and rewards migrated to `node_operator`).

accounts.name: round_record
docs: Subscription or agent settlement record. No seeds constraint — same rationale as
`finalize_round` (owner + discriminator).

accounts.name: node_operator
docs: The deactivated operator that receives the virtual slot's residual rewards. Required
whenever `virtual_node` is present.

accounts.name: round_record
docs: Subscription (`["molpha_round", feed_id, ts]`) or agent
(`["molpha_agent_round", agent, nonce]`) settlement record. No seeds constraint:
owner + discriminator suffice — only the two settle instructions can create this
account type, and both write complete state, so stored contents are trusted.

accounts.name: escrow_ata
docs: The escrow's USDC ATA — source of the settled `price`. Pinned to `agent_escrow`.

accounts.name: consumer_delegate
docs: The handler checks the delegate PDA, owner/delegate fields, and discriminator before use.

types.name: AgentStatus
docs: Lifecycle status shared by `Delegate` and `AgentEscrow`.

types.name: AggregatedSig
docs: The committed aggregate Schnorr signature. **Not verified on the happy path.**

fields.name: s
docs: Schnorr scalar `s`.

fields.name: commitment_addr
docs: Ethereum-style 20-byte commitment address of the aggregate nonce `R`.

fields.name: signers_bitmap
docs: The credited set.

types.name: Delegate
docs: Owner-scoped delegate authorization with persistent request quotas.

fields.name: status
docs: Owner pause / protocol freeze backstop.

fields.name: max_signers
docs: Per-delegate quorum ceiling; clamped to `plan.max_signers` at creation.

fields.name: epoch_cap
docs: Dormant: per-epoch credit ceiling for the future credit economy. Not enforced.

fields.name: epoch_spent
docs: Dormant: credits spent in the current epoch. Not enforced.

fields.name: epoch_id
docs: Dormant: epoch discriminator for `epoch_spent`. Not enforced.

fields.name: delegate_count
docs: Subscription delegate count after this addition.

fields.name: delegate_count
docs: Subscription delegate count after this removal.

fields.name: value
docs: Stored oracle bytes: raw payload (`FeedValueKind::Value`) or keccak digest
(`FeedValueKind::Hash`). Never longer than [`Feed::STORED_VALUE_LEN`].

fields.name: value
docs: Compacted payload stored on the feed (raw ≤32 bytes, or keccak digest).

types.name: FeedValueKind
docs: Whether [`Feed::value`] holds the raw oracle payload or a digest of a longer payload.

types.name: Gateway
docs: Bonded, Ed25519-signing gateway (v0.2 spec `gateway.authority`).
Holds endpoint metadata, bond, and reward accounting. Keyed by the gateway's Solana
authority key. `index` is the `gateway_index` referenced by `GatewayReceipt`.

fields.name: bond
docs: USDC bond held in the protocol treasury, slashable on a successful dispute.

fields.name: claimable_rewards
docs: Finalized fees, withdrawable via `claim_gateway_rewards`.

types.name: Node
docs: Slot-keyed registry entry and the single account touched by the round workflows.
Keyed by `index` (`[SEED_PREFIX, index_le]`), it carries the node's registry slot, the
secp256k1 coalition key used for Schnorr verification, and the reward balances accrued during
settlement/finalization. Management/lifecycle data lives on the owner-keyed [`NodeOperator`].

fields.name: owner
docs: Operator wallet — used for claim authorization and deactivate validation.

fields.name: secp256k1_pubkey_x
docs: Validated affine coordinates. `register_node` is the only write path and accepts only a
canonical compressed secp256k1 point, so verifier hot paths may safely skip re-parsing.

fields.name: claimable_rewards
docs: Finalized rewards, withdrawable via `claim_node_rewards`.

types.name: NodeOperator
docs: Owner-keyed management/lifecycle account for a node operator.
Keyed by `owner` (`[SEED_PREFIX, owner]`), it holds registration, deposit, status, and
connectivity data — everything that is *not* needed by the per-round workflows. The workflow
data (registry slot, coalition key, reward balances) lives on the slot-keyed [`super::Node`].
`claimable_rewards` is the landing bucket for rewards migrated out of the virtual slot when a
removal transition is finalized; it lets a deactivated operator still claim.

fields.name: claimable_rewards
docs: Rewards migrated from the virtual slot at transition close, withdrawable via
`claim_node_rewards` after deactivation.

fields.name: max_delegates
docs: Max delegates/agents an owner on this plan may provision.

fields.name: protocol_fee
docs: Fixed protocol fee per settled round (v0.2 §4.2 / §6).

fields.name: dispute_window_slots
docs: Slots a settled round must wait before `finalize_round` can run (dispute window).

fields.name: gateway_bond_min
docs: Minimum USDC bond a gateway must post to settle receipts.

fields.name: challenger_bounty_bps
docs: Challenger reward, in bps of the slashed bond, on a successful dispute.

fields.name: registry_cooldown_secs
docs: Monotonic counter assigning `gateway_index` to bonded gateways.

fields.name: previous_grace_secs
docs: Grace period after activation during which the previous registry version remains valid.

fields.name: agent_round_base
docs: Base price of an agent `FreshRound` request (USDC atomic units).

fields.name: agent_round_per_sig
docs: Per-required-signature price component of a `FreshRound` request.
Solvency invariant (ops-enforced): `agent_round_per_sig >= reward_per_signature`
and `agent_round_base >= redundancy_buffer * reward_per_signature + gateway_fee`.

fields.name: agent_epoch_len_secs
docs: Length of the agent spend epoch (e.g. 86_400 for daily); must be > 0.

types.name: RoundReceiptRecord
docs: Per-round settlement record.

types.name: Secp256k1KeyClaim
docs: Permanent reservation for a secp256k1 node key.
The PDA is keyed by `keccak256(compressed_pubkey)`. Claims are intentionally never closed:
once a key has represented a Molpha node it cannot later be replayed for another identity.

fields.name: agg_sig_s
docs: Schnorr signature R component
